boundary_evidence: NOT FROM tu_map. tools/tu_map.py reports the arm9 main module as UNDER-SEGMENTED, so there is no tu_map boundary or tubuild.py create candidate id here; every line below is hand-derived and independently checkable.

contiguous linker run 0x020169d8..0x02017168: the former per-function delinks entries tile the span exactly with no hole (config/arm9/delinks.txt, config/arm9/symbols.txt). The run starts at the first function after dExtAnmModel_c C2 (0x02016998..0x020169d8).

class-family homogeneity: every named symbol is a member of dExtSimpleModel_c (cartridge dExtSimpleModel_c, _ZTV17dExtSimpleModel_c at 0x0208e90c) or its root dExtModel_c (_ZTV11dExtModel_c at 0x0208e87c), or an unnamed helper those members call. notes/model-rtti-names.md records the cartridge class name.

neighbour above: the six _ZThn80_ destructor-thunk shards at 0x02017168..0x020171c8. A member destructor of dExtAnmModel_c, dExtBlendAnmModel_c or dExtAnm2Model_c is what emits them, and that definition also emits those classes D-variants, which already have homes below 0x020169d8. Defining them here also emitted .exceptix for the whole TU, so the thunks stay enrolled on their own shards.

compiler_only_output.reason: one dExtModel_c() emits the complete-object C1 beside the licensed base-object C2; the ROM has no configured C1 home (nothing constructs a complete dExtModel_c) and no surviving function references it. The C2 shard objisolate kept only C2.

notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by tubuild.py create: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from.

The licensed span is 0x020169d8..0x02017168, 32 functions. One ~dExtSimpleModel_c() emits D2, D0, D1 and one dExtSimpleModel_c() emits C1, C2, and the cartridge homes all five in that order. One ~dExtModel_c() emits D2, D0, D1 in the cartridge order. One dExtModel_c() emits C1 beside C2; C1 is deadstripped because the cartridge homes only C2, which is the variant objisolate kept from the C2 shard.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen.

RTTI is off. It was turned off while dExtSimpleModel_c / dExtModel_c carried coined names whose _ZTS/_ZTI records had no home; under the cartridge spellings they would, so RTTI on is open as a follow-up. The two vtables deadstrip-data onto _ZTV17dExtSimpleModel_c and _ZTV11dExtModel_c.
The six _ZThn80_ thunks at 0x02017168..0x020171c8 are not claimed. Including the MI member destructors that emit them also emitted an .exceptix section per function in this TU.
common.h precedes dExtSimpleModel_c.h so this TU sees the flat Matrix4x3 { s32 m[12]; } spelling.
